headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录247篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究155篇, 开源项目47篇, 模型发布33篇, 产品/API12篇。热门标签：Agent（63篇）。其中11%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ ayghri /i-have-adhd：A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.

▸ Tencent /teamai-cli：Make Every Team AI Native

▸ obra /superpowers：An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

▸ pascalorg /editor：Open-source 3D architectural editor with a local CLI, MCP tools, and practical workflows for humans 

▸ earthtojake /text-to-cad：A library of agent skills for CAD, CAE and CAM
